{{Quote|Dee'ja Peak is a beautiful place to study nature. That's how I wound up here.|Damalia Korde|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Damalia Korde''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was interested in nature and biology. Korde had traveled to the city of [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to study the local wildlife and never left again because she liked the place very much. She was then given a job as a groundskeeper.<ref name="SWG" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] the courier [[Bor Ting]] was sent to deliver a [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]] to her that contained information about the [[Berserker Virus]]. When Ting took a leg injury on his way through the Nabooian countryside, Korde hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to find him and bring the datadisc to her.<ref name="SWG" />
